doomedbgfix.cut.title: Amputate
doomedbgfix.cut.hint.saw: Hold and saw left and right
doomedbgfix.cut.hint.contact: Keep the blade on the cut line
doomedbgfix.cut.hint.paused: Paused. The cut stays open and keeps bleeding.
doomedbgfix.cut.tq.ok: Tourniquet above the cut - flow blocked
doomedbgfix.cut.tq.bad: Tourniquet is BELOW the cut - useless
doomedbgfix.eye.amputation.title: Eye Amputation
doomedbgfix.eye.amputation.hint: Carefully cut the conjunctiva and sever the optic nerve
doomedbgfix.eye.implant.not_doomed: You need to be Doomed to use this.
doomedbgfix.eye.implant.no_empty_socket: There is no empty eye socket to fit an implant into.
doomedbgfix.eye.cut.title: Eye removal
doomedbgfix.eye.cut.hint.0: Hold LMB and trace the scalpel around the rim of the eye
doomedbgfix.eye.cut.hint.1: Saw back and forth across each muscle
doomedbgfix.eye.cut.hint.2: Cut across the optic nerve at the bottom
